Profile: F. Wendtman
Position: PG | Number: 28 | Team: Chuckers Chuckers

The Rundown
Wendtman is a high-motor, undersized floor general who makes his presence felt on both ends. This is a stat-stuffer — leading his squad in points, assists, steals, and blocks while ranking second in rebounds. For a smaller guard, that 4.1 RPG shows serious nose-for-the-ball instincts and willingness to scrap in traffic.

Strengths
• Elite ball-hawking ability. That 2.4 SPG jumps off the page. Wendtman lives in passing lanes and creates chaos defensively. The 0.6 BPG is unusual for a small guard — suggests excellent timing and verticality.
• Solid assist-to-turnover ratio. At 3.3 AST to 1.3 TO (~2.5:1), he takes care of the rock while running the show.
• Disciplined. Just 0.5 fouls per game means he plays aggressive defense without fouling out — a rare skill.

Areas for Development
• Perimeter shooting needs work. The 28.9% from deep on ~3 attempts per game is a red flag at the next level. Defenders will go under screens.
• Free throw percentage (66.7%) suggests mechanical issues that may explain the 3PT struggles.

NBA Comparison
Jose Alvarado meets TJ McConnell
A pest on defense who generates turnovers through sheer effort and anticipation. Won't wow you with shooting, but contributes everywhere else. The type of glue guy every winning team needs.
